Great opportunity if you are into or considering governance/policy (9/27 app deadline):
> The IAPS AI Policy Fellowship is a 12-week, fully-funded program for aspiring AI policy professionals. The program kicks off with a two-week D.C. residency with workshops and networking. Fellows spend 10 weeks working with expert mentors on real projects—writing briefs, briefing officials, organizing convenings—with a $18–27k stipend, healthcare. Past Fellows have gone on to roles at RAND, Institute for Progress, and in government. *Apply by Sep 27.*
> 
> *Applications are open for the <https://www.iaps.ai/fellowship|Spring 2027 IAPS AI Policy Fellowship>!*
> 
> :date: *Dates:* Feb 22 - May 14, 2027
> :round_pushpin: *Location:* Washington, D.C., London, or Remote
> :moneybag: *Stipend:* Senior Fellows $24k, Fellows $18k; plus $3k for D.C. and London fellows
> :bangbang: *Deadline to apply*: September 27, 11:59 PM Pacific Time

From John Yan:
> My org <https://gutenberg.ai/|Gutenberg> is hiring! Website's a bit outdated: we build interp tools for model forensics. More on <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pnb-HPZv4el84yq6MdQuKIyXZ7JZwBuEsAFIrl70-Sk/edit?tab=t.0|the agenda here>. We're SF based, 6 people, talent dense. Submit interest by pinging me at <mailto:john@gutenberg.ai|john@gutenberg.ai>

:wave:  London folks!

Apollo Research is hosting a social tomorrow evening (*Weds 23 Sept*) at *The Princess of Shoreditch,* from *7–9:30pm*. There will be drinks and food, and it's a relaxed opportunity to meet members of the Apollo team.

We have a few spaces left. If you haven't had the chance to meet us yet, and think you (or someone you know well) could be a strong fit for one of our <https://www.apolloresearch.ai/careers#jobs|open roles>, please register: <https://luma.com/2yjzelfz|luma.com/2yjzelfz>

Hope to see some of you there! Message me with any questions :slightly_smiling_face:

Unique AI Safety Op from Eric Huang at xAI.  Think carefully about this job as it will require a significant amount of swimming against the current.  You will also get a broad exposure to AI Safety work at a lab (as there are only 2 of you).  Remember what Buck and Neel have said about <https://blog.redwoodresearch.org/p/ten-people-on-the-inside|good AI Safety people on the inside>....

> The xAI safety team is hiring an fte to start immediately! I'm looking for strong engineers who will dig in and work tirelessly to make an impact. I'm currently the only person working on all production safety training and monitoring. To be frank, I'm completely out of capacity and need more help. Concretely, I expect a marginal hire to counterfactually allow us to run a smoother production training process and substantially reduce our short-term prosaic catastrophic risk. You will be given the lateral cover to take charge of the majority of safety production training, help fight other fires that arise, and implement whatever you think is the most important to get right across the stack.
> 
> This work will be challenging, but if this excites you, please reach out to John to express interest!

AI Safety/Security consulting with the big firms may start being a thing , FYI.

“Arcadia Impact’s alignment team is growing and has encouragement from several parties to be ambitious. Both roles would pay well and let you do high-impact work on pressing alignment questions! *Please apply by September 20th* and reach out to Andrew (<mailto:andrew@arcadiaimpact.org|andrew@arcadiaimpact.org>) if you have any questions ”
